views.name: cars_base_measures
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cars_data.Id AS Id,
  CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(cars_data.MPG), '') AS REAL) AS MPG,
  cars_data.Cylinders AS Cylinders,
  cars_data.Edispl AS Edispl,
  CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(cars_data.Horsepower), '') AS REAL) AS Horsepower,
  cars_data.Weight AS Weight,
  cars_data.Accelerate AS Accelerate,
  cars_data.Year AS Year
FROM cars_data
views.description: Normalized car measurement rows with numeric casts and preserved identifiers. Use this to compute aggregates or join to descriptive tables without worrying about numeric types stored as text. | Use for: Average MPG or Horsepower by maker, year, or country; Filter cars by numeric criteria (MPG thresholds, horsepower ranges); Time-series trends by Year for performance measures

views.name: cars_with_names_and_models
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cd.Id AS Id,
  cn.MakeId AS MakeId,
  cn.Model AS Model,
  cn.Make AS Make,
  ml.ModelId AS ModelId,
  ml.Maker AS MakerId,
  cd.MPG AS MPG,
  cd.Cylinders AS Cylinders,
  cd.Edispl AS Edispl,
  cd.Horsepower AS Horsepower,
  cd.Weight AS Weight,
  cd.Accelerate AS Accelerate,
  cd.Year AS Year
FROM cars_data cd
LEFT JOIN car_names cn ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
LEFT JOIN model_list ml ON cn.Model = ml.Model
views.description: Denormalized view joining car measurements to car_names and model_list where available. Keeps name/model identifiers to enable grouping by model or joining onward to maker and geography. | Use for: List cars with their model and maker identifiers; Aggregate measures by model or maker; Find mismatches where model text has no model_list entry

views.name: makers_with_country_continent
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  car_makers.Id AS Id,
  car_makers.Maker AS Maker,
  car_makers.FullName AS FullName,
  car_makers.Country AS Country,
  countries.CountryName AS CountryName,
  countries.Continent AS ContinentId,
  continents.Continent AS Continent
FROM car_makers
LEFT JOIN countries ON car_makers.Country = countries.CountryId
LEFT JOIN continents ON countries.Continent = continents.ContId
views.description: Car makers enriched with their country and continent names. Use this to analyze makers by geography or roll up measures to country/continent. | Use for: Count makers per country or continent; Filter makers by country or continent; Join maker geography to car measurements

views.name: cars_enriched_full
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cd.Id AS Id,
  cn.MakeId AS MakeId,
  cn.Model AS Model,
  cn.Make AS Make,
  ml.ModelId AS ModelId,
  ml.Maker AS MakerId,
  cm.Maker AS Maker,
  cm.FullName AS FullName,
  cm.Country AS Country,
  co.CountryName AS CountryName,
  co.Continent AS ContinentId,
  ct.Continent AS Continent,
  cd.MPG AS MPG,
  cd.Cylinders AS Cylinders,
  cd.Edispl AS Edispl,
  cd.Horsepower AS Horsepower,
  cd.Weight AS Weight,
  cd.Accelerate AS Accelerate,
  cd.Year AS Year
FROM cars_data cd
LEFT JOIN car_names cn ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
LEFT JOIN model_list ml ON cn.Model = ml.Model
LEFT JOIN car_makers cm ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
LEFT JOIN countries co ON cm.Country = co.CountryId
LEFT JOIN continents ct ON co.Continent = ct.ContId
views.description: Fully denormalized car facts: car measurement rows joined through names, models, makers, countries, and continents. Good for reporting and ad-hoc queries that need both measures and full descriptive context. | Use for: Report average measures by continent/country/maker/model; List cars with full maker and geographic context; Filter car inventory by maker country or continent and measure thresholds

views.name: avg_measures_by_maker_year
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ml.Maker AS MakerId,
  cd.Year AS Year,
  AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(cd.MPG), '') AS REAL)) AS Avg_MPG,
  AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(cd.Horsepower), '') AS REAL)) AS Avg_Horsepower,
  AVG(cd.Weight) AS Avg_Weight,
  AVG(cd.Edispl) AS Avg_Edispl,
  AVG(cd.Accelerate) AS Avg_Accelerate,
  AVG(cd.Cylinders) AS Avg_Cylinders,
  COUNT(cd.Id) AS Count_Cars
FROM cars_data cd
LEFT JOIN car_names cn ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
LEFT JOIN model_list ml ON cn.Model = ml.Model
GROUP BY ml.Maker, cd.Year
views.description: Aggregated average numeric measures per maker (maker id) and year. Use for trend analysis or comparing makers over time. Relies on casting/cleaning being handled downstream or by selecting from cars_base_measures. | Use for: Which maker has highest average MPG in a given year; Trends of horsepower or weight by maker across years; Compare average measures between makers for a specific year

views.name: car_count_by_country
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cm.Country AS Country,
  co.CountryName AS CountryName,
  COUNT(cd.Id) AS Count_Cars
FROM cars_data cd
LEFT JOIN car_names cn ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
LEFT JOIN model_list ml ON cn.Model = ml.Model
LEFT JOIN car_makers cm ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
LEFT JOIN countries co ON cm.Country = co.CountryId
GROUP BY cm.Country, co.CountryName
views.description: Counts of car_name entries (or measurement rows) associated with each country. Useful to understand distribution of cars by maker country; joins through model_list and car_makers. | Use for: Which countries have the most car entries; Distribution of car models by country; Filter countries by minimum number of cars

views.name: maker_rank_by_avg_mpg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ag.MakerId AS MakerId,
  ag.Avg_MPG AS Avg_MPG,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ag.Avg_MPG DESC) AS MPG_Rank
FROM (
  SELECT
    ml.Maker AS MakerId,
    AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(cd.MPG), '') AS REAL)) AS Avg_MPG
  FROM cars_data cd
  LEFT JOIN car_names cn ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
  LEFT JOIN model_list ml ON cn.Model = ml.Model
  GROUP BY ml.Maker
) ag
views.description: Ranks makers by their average MPG across all available years. Exposes a dense rank so downstream queries can filter top-N makers by rank. Use this to get top-performing makers on MPG. | Use for: Top-N makers by average MPG; Compare maker ranks for fuel efficiency; Filter makers with rank <= K for reporting

views.name: latest_model_entry_per_make
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.Id AS Id,
  t.MakeId AS MakeId,
  t.Year AS Year,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.MakeId ORDER BY t.Year DESC) AS Year_Rank,
  t.MPG AS MPG,
  t.Horsepower AS Horsepower,
  t.Weight AS Weight,
  t.Cylinders AS Cylinders,
  t.Accelerate AS Accelerate
FROM (
  SELECT
    cd.Id AS Id,
    cn.MakeId AS MakeId,
    cd.Year AS Year,
    cd.MPG AS MPG,
    cd.Horsepower AS Horsepower,
    cd.Weight AS Weight,
    cd.Cylinders AS Cylinders,
    cd.Accelerate AS Accelerate
  FROM cars_data cd
  LEFT JOIN car_names cn ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
) t
views.description: Selects the latest Year entry per MakeId (car_name) based on Year. Exposes Year_Rank where 1 indicates the latest measurement for that MakeId. Useful for deduplicating multiple measurements per named car. | Use for: Get latest measurement per named car; De-duplicate multiple rows per MakeId keeping newest Year; Filter to Year_Rank = 1 to analyze current specs
